links.rationale: FB2-SW-SWR-000001 requires 20 Hz acquisition, PEC/CRC validation before database write, and database publish within 5 ms. The specification's requirement_traceability entry records that one of those three - the PEC/CRC criterion - has an executed unit assertion, in the LTC 6813-1 PEC oracle group, and that the two timing criteria are neither asserted nor assertable in a harness that mocks the timebase and the SPI/DMA transfer. The verification_state recorded is partially_verified_at_unit_level. A verifies link is recorded because the specification does address the requirement and states what it does and does not reach; it is not recorded as evidence that the requirement is met.

FB2-SW-SWR-000002 requires a 10 ms limit-check latency, 1 mV threshold accuracy against the configured limits and a 5 ms transition to FAULT. The specification records that 0 of those 3 criteria have an executed unit assertion: the only tests reaching src/app/application/soa/soa.c assert NULL-argument rejection, which is a defensive contract no requirement states. The 60 assertions on src/app/application/config/soa_cfg.c verify a configuration table, not the monitoring behaviour. verification_state is recorded as not_verified_at_unit_level and the link exists so that the absence is visible from the requirement rather than only from the verification side of the corpus.

FB2-SW-SWR-000003 requires the OPEN to PRECHARGE to CLOSE to HOLD state machine, a 5 ms fault response and auxiliary feedback readback after every command. The specification records that the only test file for src/app/driver/contactor/contactor.c was a build failure in the recorded SIL host run, so nothing about this requirement executed, and that the file's 2 surviving assertions concern registry shape rather than any state transition. verification_state is not_verified_at_unit_level.

The specification's measurement_state.recorded_run block is read directly out of docs/artifacts/evidence/actual-runs/foxbms2-sil-host-unit-test-macos-2026-09-29/results-sil-all.json, which is the evidence the execution record FB2-VER-EXE-000015 registers: 313 test files selected, 222 green, 7 red, 84 build failures, 988 assertion sites reported of which 950 passed, 35 failed and 3 were ignored. The specification adds no execution of its own and is not an independent confirmation of that record; its limitations say so explicitly.

FB2-VER-TMS-000004 is the unit test measure for the LTC 6813-1 AFE measurement cycle and PEC validation, the one requirement in this corpus whose criterion the specification finds an executed analytical oracle for. The specification's MOD-LTC-6813-1 group names the three real test files whose assertions discharge that measure and records the recorded-run counter for each beside the current-tree assertion-site count.

FB2-VER-TMS-000001 is the unit test measure for SOA voltage limit monitoring. The specification consumes it to state, per requirement, what the named tests actually assert: on MOD-SOA that the only assertions are TEST_ASSERT_FAIL_ASSERT on NULL arguments and that no acceptance criterion of FB2-SW-SWR-000002 is reached. The measure records what the test does; the specification records whether that constitutes a verification basis, which for this group it does not.

FB2-VER-TMS-000002 is the unit test measure for the contactor state machine. The specification consumes it to record that the tests it names for src/app/driver/contactor/contactor.c were a build failure in the recorded run, so the measure has no execution behind it and FB2-SW-SWR-000003 is unverified at unit level.
